description:
## Problem
Two bugs in `MemoryCache`:

1. **TTL expiry in `get` does not remove URL from `@insertion_order`** — `@insertion_order` grows unboundedly with stale URLs that have already been evicted from `@cache`. During eviction in `set`, the loop iterates over dead entries.

2. **Overwrite in `set` does not move URL to end of `@insertion_order`** — Updated entries keep their original insertion position, breaking LRU semantics. Entries are evicted based on insertion time, not last access/update time.

## Files
- `src/vug/cache.cr` (lines 18-46)

## Fix
1. In `get`, delete the URL from `@insertion_order` when a TTL-expired entry is found.
2. In `set`, when overwriting an existing entry, move the URL to the end of `@insertion_order`.

## Acceptance
- `@insertion_order` stays in sync with `@cache` keys
- Updated entries get evicted last (LRU behavior)
- Existing cache tests pass
- New tests for TTL expiry cleanup and LRU ordering
title: Fix MemoryCache insertion-order bugs: TTL expiry cleanup, LRU on overwrite
